name: Venice
living: gondolas drift slowly across the lagoon behind the outfield wall
lantern and window reflections ripple and shimmer in the lagoon
the quay lamp posts flicker warmly
palazzo and church windows glow and flicker
the pink dusk clouds drift slowly (sky layer drift)
a few gulls glide across the dusk sky now and then
stars begin to twinkle in the blue-violet sky
the scoreboard's diamond outline pulses softly
the light-tower lamp banks breathe gently, moths drifting through their cones
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
